name: Starry Gradient Glow Hero

description.zh: 深色星空底上铺满细密星点，底部由紫罗兰渐变过渡到深蓝，中央超大无衬线标题带金属银灰渐变，胶囊按钮外裹一圈柔和光晕，整体像夜空中的发光招牌。
description.en: A deep night-sky canvas speckled with fine stars, its lower half washed in a violet-to-blue gradient. An oversized sans-serif headline carries a metallic silver sheen, while a pill button sits inside a soft halo of light, reading like a glowing signboard in the dark.

reconstructionPrompt: A full-bleed dark hero section on a starry night background: scattered tiny star dots over near-black, with a soft violet-to-blue gradient rising from the bottom edge. Centered stack: a small rounded pill badge reading a short beta label, a very large bold sans-serif headline in two lines with a metallic silver gradient fill, a two-line muted grey subheading, and a pill-shaped outlined call-to-action button with a trailing arrow icon wrapped in a soft outer glow. The gradient hue slowly drifts between violet and blue while all other elements remain static.
